# Zorin

> Zorin is a pricing intelligence tool for Shopify and WooCommerce merchants. It fits a per-SKU demand curve from your sales history using log-log OLS elasticity regression and returns raise/lower/hold recommendations with a confidence score and estimated profit lift. Pricing campaigns let merchants schedule and auto-revert bulk price changes across their catalog. A profit tracking dashboard shows monthly P&L, per-product gross profit, and campaign performance. A Van Westendorp Price Sensitivity survey lets merchants ask customers directly what they would pay. A Launch Planner provides deterministic pricing for products with no sales history yet. Competitor prices can be tracked per product and feed into the Launch Planner automatically.

## Core pages

- [Home](https://www.tryzorin.com): Marketing landing page with feature overview and pricing.
- [Features](https://www.tryzorin.com/features): Full feature grid — elasticity modeling, pricing campaigns, profit tracking, competitor benchmarking, price sensitivity surveys, and Launch Planner.
- [Shopify integration](https://www.tryzorin.com/integrations/shopify): Connect your Shopify store via Admin API.
- [WooCommerce integration](https://www.tryzorin.com/integrations/woocommerce): Connect your WooCommerce store via REST API keys.
- [Free profit margin calculator](https://www.tryzorin.com/shopify-profit-margin-calculator): Free tool — enter selling price, unit cost, and shipping to get profit and margin instantly.
- [Terms of Service](https://www.tryzorin.com/terms): Plain-English terms of service.

## Features

- **Elasticity modeling**: Log-log OLS regression fitted per SKU from your order history. Requires at least 6 months of sales data with price variation. Returns a RAISE / LOWER / HOLD recommendation with confidence (Strong / Fair / Weak) based on R² and data-point count.
- **Pricing campaigns**: Rules engine with four modes — flat percentage change, ML recommendation, competitor match, or fixed price. Campaigns are scheduled, execute automatically in 30-product chunks via a cron job, and auto-revert when the campaign window ends. Conflict detection prevents two campaigns from owning the same product simultaneously.
- **Profit tracking dashboard**: Monthly P&L trend chart (revenue, COGS, gross profit) for the last 24 months. Per-product profit leaderboard with configurable 30/90/365-day windows. Campaign performance comparison vs prior-period baseline with honesty flags for incomplete data.
- **Competitor price benchmarking**: Add competitor names, prices, and URLs per product. View min/median/max stats. Competitor prices prefill the Launch Planner automatically.
- **Van Westendorp Price Sensitivity survey**: Generate a shareable, no-login survey link per product. Customers answer four classic Van Westendorp questions (too cheap / good value / getting expensive / too expensive). Results show the Optimal Price Point, Indifference Price Point, and acceptable price range with a confidence tier based on response count.
- **Launch Planner**: Deterministic pricing tool for products with no sales history. Takes unit cost, target margin, fulfillment cost, competitor prices, and positioning choice (budget / mid-market / premium). Returns a recommended launch price, minimum viable price, break-even plan, and plain-English rationale. Works from day one — no historical data required.
- **Multi-user teams**: Owner and Member roles. Owners manage billing and team; Members get full product and pricing access. Email invite flow with token-based accept.
- **Promotion flagging**: Auto-detects promotional sales spikes using z-score outlier analysis and excludes flagged records from elasticity model fitting to prevent skewed recommendations.
- **Shopify sync**: Real-time webhook receiver (HMAC-verified, delivery-deduped) for product and order updates. Manual sync also available.
- **WooCommerce sync**: Full product refresh and incremental order sync via REST API. Real-time webhook receiver for product and order updates.
- **Price write-back**: Applied prices push directly to Shopify (blocking, rolls back on failure) and WooCommerce (non-blocking).

## About

Zorin is built for independent and small-to-midsize Shopify and WooCommerce sellers who want data-backed pricing without a data science background. The elasticity model is transparent — merchants can see the demand curve and the math behind every recommendation. The Van Westendorp survey works from day one with no sales history required. Plans start at $39/month with a 7-day free trial (no credit card required).
